issues.detail: The Greek 'εν τω θεω ημων λαλησαι' (in the presence of our God) is rendered as 'trong Đức Chúa Trời của chúng tôi' (in/within our God). The Vietnamese construction suggests being *inside* or *within* the person of God, whereas the Greek 'εν' in this context denotes 'in the presence of'.
